text: Greenfield audit supersedes the earlier compatibility and historical-system wording. ScalaFIM is unreleased; LNA 2 is a current versioned format; response/archive APIs use factual names; the central latent codec facade and forwarding aliases are deleted; LNA recognition is assembled from independent immutable registry binding values; and the frozen corpus is numerical regression evidence. Earlier notes remain only as an immutable record of the superseded decision.
